rows.verdict_le10: <strong>At the delicate art of combining the bizarre and the mundane
rows.dek_lead: At the delicate art of combining the bizarre and the mundane, nobody is more skillful than Rainer Werner Fassbinder. His formula is wickedly simple. He begins, often enough, with elements of lurid sexuality.
